title: Dungeon Exploration
paragraphs: “Even if we’re watching over you, please protect yourselves. Reckless charges are strictly forbidden.”
“Got it, na-no!”
“Okay—”
“I’ll do my best!”
“Kou will do his best too—”
Rival and the Filolials all answered together. And so, the safe team formations were decided.
“Uh… Gaelion-san, please pair up with Windia-san and do your best. As for the Filolials…”
“They’ve helped us raise our levels, so they’ve got plenty of experience, right?”
“Should we let them move as a separate unit? They might be too strong, making it hard for the others to gain experience.”
“It’s a tricky problem. Either way, I think I’ll have them act separately from Imia and the others.”
“I-I’ll do my best.”

The Mole showed her determination to Father. Father discussed the complicated team formations with Ren and the others. After all, level isn’t everything. Since those who recognized the face of the projectile hero were to remain in town, we left them behind.
“Alright, shall we head out?”

In the end, it was decided that we would aim for the bottom of the dungeon while providing appropriate experience along the way. According to Rival, he sensed that a dragon had claimed territory in the dungeon we were about to challenge.
I’m getting excited! I’ll definitely offer the Dragon Emperor as a sacrifice!
“We’ll handle the traps and mechanisms, so Eclair-san, Windia-chan, Imia-chan, and Gaelion-chan, take care of the monsters, okay?”
“Father, what about me and the Filolials?”
“Sakura-chan and the others will scout with Motoyasu-kun. Motoyasu-kun, you mustn’t go wild. If you do, the dungeon might collapse. So, you’ll focus on supporting Sakura-chan and the others.”
“Understood! So, I should provide magical support, yes?”

“Make sure not to use any offensive magic, okay? If you cast fire magic in the dungeon, you’ll not only deplete the oxygen but also risk catching allies in the blast. You wouldn’t want Sakura-chan and the others turning into roast chicken because of you, right?”
“I-I’ll focus on healing magic!”
What terrifying advice! I absolutely cannot use attack magic! I’m not great at support magic, but I’ll use this as an opportunity to practice.
“This reminds me of training beginners.”
“It’s similar, but it’s more like a guild or team expedition or drill. It brings back memories of helping the members gain experience.”
Father seems to have a lot of experience with this kind of organized leadership. Even if it’s a bit harsh, giving them this experience is likely intended to help them take the next step.
“Everyone, when you fight monsters, make sure you do so with resolve. It’s never okay to take a life carelessly just because it feels like a game.”
Everyone nodded at Father’s words.
“If you kill recklessly just to become stronger, nothing good will come of it. Don’t forget what lies beyond your battles!”
Ren spoke with a sincerity that seemed impossible compared to the last loop! This is truly surprising! I wish I could show this to the Ren from the previous loop.
“What is it, Motoyasu? Did you think I was just aiming to be the strongest like it was a game?”
“I didn’t think anything like that, I say.”
“Then what’s with that look?”
“I was just thinking that Ren spoke with a sincerity that seemed impossible compared to the last loop! This is truly surprising! I wish I could show this to the Ren from the previous loop!”
“…That’s slightly irritating, but whatever.”
After saying that, Ren spoke again.

“Until you showed me the truth, I just wanted to become stronger. But now… it’s different. The goal of saving the world is too big for me to grasp, but fighting to protect the people I’ve met… I think I understand that.”
Ren didn’t sound entirely convinced. He seems to still be struggling with some doubts.
“I no longer think that just being strong is enough.”
“Well, I get where you’re coming from.”
“Indeed. We’re doing this groundwork so we can protect the world from the waves together. They may not be our juniors, but everyone here is working to become strong enough to face the waves.”
“It’s not just the heroes who can fight against the waves. Eclair-san, Windia-chan, and Imia-chan are proving that through their actions.”

“Yeah, this is our goal! The rules of this world may create an illusion, but in the end, it’s all about killing each other… It’s not how the people I know fight. I’ll only fight and level up against those who come at us with hostility!”
Ren declared firmly.
“You know someone like that?”
“From a VR game?”
“Yeah… I never thought their philosophy would mean something here. Now I understand that it’s disrespectful to face an opponent in battle without the resolve to kill.”
Since Ren looked slightly displeased, neither Father nor Itsuki pressed him any further.
“Alright… let’s head into the dungeon.”
“Yeah!”

With that, we proceeded deeper into the dungeon. Along the way, Éclair led the group, while the assistants, the mole, and Rival held their own against the monsters. Our job was limited to staying on guard in case of an ambush. Of course, I was mapping the area with the Filolials. The battles inside the dungeon seemed to be progressing fairly well. The dungeon started with narrow passages, followed by mazes, the occasional large chamber, and rooms filled with traps—an endless series of challenges. At the beginning, we occasionally encountered adventurers, but as we ventured deeper, we sometimes came across corpses and scattered bones. If they had been defeated by monsters, they would have been consumed, but the bodies of those who had fallen into pit traps or other hazards had rotted and turned into zombies. Naturally, for the sake of hygiene, I took care of any areas that reeked of decay using magic. With that, we kept delving deeper into the dungeon as though it was just another training exercise.
“It’s a deeper dungeon than I expected.”
“The traps are quite elaborate too.”
“Yeah, and it looks like monsters come to periodically reset or repair them.”
“The dragon’s probably using its tamed minions to handle that, I say.”
“If we were on the dungeon management side instead of the hero side, this would actually be pretty fun… well, if this were just a game.”
“I’m not sure that would be enjoyable in this world though. I mean, there are waves, and the real enemies are humans, right?”
“True.”
We were taking a short break with Father and the others.
“That being said, I can feel the Dragon Emperor’s presence getting closer.”
“Well, I suppose we should be the ones to take the lead in the boss fight. Everyone seems to have gained enough experience.”
“There were quite a few close calls though. How many times did we have to stop reckless charges, thinking we’d protect everyone?”
Father glanced at Rival, the assistants, and Mole. They were all looking down, clearly reflecting on their actions.
“No matter how much we’re watching over you, you can’t just throw away your defense, okay? If it gets dangerous, you need to dodge or defend yourselves.”
“Yes…”
“That’s a valid concern. With Naofumi-san around, they can focus purely on offense.”
Itsuki stepped in to defend the assistants.
Exactly! Father’s defense is the strongest in the world.
“It’s fine to include me in your coordination, but relying too much on avoiding defensive actions is a problem. If I’m not there and something happens, you’ll die.”
“That’s… true. Honestly, it scares me because I might start forgetting that.”
“Especially you, Itsuki. You’re often in the same position as Naofumi, and your combat compatibility is too good.”
“I block the attacks, and Itsuki provides covering fire.”
“And even if he misfires, Naofumi-san can handle it without a problem. He’s a model frontline fighter.”
“That’s not a compliment I want to hear, okay? Please spare me. Dying because I got shot by an ally from behind? No thanks.”
Father was saying something ominous. But Itsuki was careful in that regard. In fact, I’ve never seen him misfire.
“As long as you’re hitting the target, there’s no problem. And according to Itsuki, he feels safer when I’m in front.”
“Ren-san, you sure hold grudges.”
While this back-and-forth was going on, Éclair was maintaining her sword. I was busy wiping the dirt off the Filolials. After all, this place was pretty filthy.
